title.en: Fable 2 — The Fox and the Grapes

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: A fox saw some grapes up high.
The grapes were big and beautiful.
He jumped once, twice and three times.
He walked off and said: the grapes are sour.

sentences.ar: מה שאדם לא מקבל, הוא לא אוהב.
sentences.en: What a person cannot get, he decides he does not want.
